title: 'Les Bleus' get ready for their second World Cup game against Iraq
summary: It's time for the World Cup roundup! Mo Salah scored his third World Cup goal, allowing Egypt to get his first win in the tournament after 92 years. French fans are gearing up for their second game against Iraq in Philadelphia, while Norway is getting ready to play Senegal. FRANCE 24's Emily Boyles tells us what to know.
